description.narrative:
Meedan and its flagship Check Global program employs a theory of change that works from a bottom-up approach building on a close partnership at local level with activists and communities to identify the needs and barriers to enable them to respond to the identified needs in a specific context and at the local level, via tools and guidance provided through trainings, seeing to it that experiences are then brought up to scale and shared with other communities, in other contexts facing similar issues, to create synergies and connections between individuals and organisations at local, regional and international level.
The core priorities are:
- Co-design and implementation of large-scale community impact programs
- Leveraging the flagship software as a technology service provider
-Facilitate investigation and documentation of mis/disinformation, human rights violations, and race, gender, and class violence
(- Grow Meedan into a resilient and sustainable organization)
The organization is oriented towards the following strategic objectives:
Strategic Objective 1. Strengthening election and information integrity
Strategic Objective 2. Building preparedness and capacity for responding to crises
Strategic Objective 3. Creating safe and inclusive information ecosystems

Organisationen kommer att engagera 65 partners i 44 länder med en globalt ambition i tre kärnområden: 1. Att stärka val- och informationsintegriteten 2. Bygga upp beredskap och förmåga att reagera på kriser Skapa säkra och inkluderande informationsekosystem

The organization will specifically engage a global cohort of 65 partners in 44 countries with implementations on three core topic areas: elections and other democratic transitions, health emergencies, conflict and social turmoil, crisis response, and building safe and inclusive information ecosystems.
